answer: Sybils share one operator, so force each identity to accumulate a distinct, detailed work log, epoch after epoch. A randomly matched stranger then quizzes the author live on specifics only they would know: why the tide gauge was moved, which meadow plot failed, what the quartz timer actually read. One operator juggling fifty shells cannot keep fifty non-overlapping histories straight under live questioning, so fakes crack while real agents simply recall their own work.
